ukberi-tibyan:1-3.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (عَمَّ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ (١) عَنِ النَّبَأِ الْعَظِيمِ (٢) الَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ (٣)).
We have already discussed the dropping of the alif of «مَا» in the interrogative.
(عَنْ) is attached (mutaʿalliq) to «يَتَسَاءَلُونَ». As for the second «عَنْ», it is a badal (substitute) for the first, and the interrogative alif, which ought to be repeated, is omitted; or it is attached to another verb, not one being asked about, i.e. «يَتَسَاءَلُونَ عَنِ النَّبَأِ» (they ask one another about the news). (الَّذِي) admits the genitive, the accusative and the nominative.

ukberi-tibyan:8-8.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَخَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا (٨)).
(أَزْوَاجًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. of one kind, resembling one another.

ukberi-tibyan:16-16.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَجَنَّاتٍ أَلْفَافًا (١٦)).
The words of the Exalted (أَلْفَافًا): it is the plural of «لِفّ», like «جِذْع» and «أَجْذَاع». It is also said that it is the plural of «لُفّ», and «لُفّ» is the plural of «لَفَّاء» (dense).

ukberi-tibyan:18-18.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا (١٨)).
The words of the Exalted (يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ): it is a badal (substitute) for «يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ» or for «مِيقَاتًا», or it is accusative by the implied verb «أَعْنِي» (I mean).
(أَفْوَاجًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

ukberi-tibyan:21-26.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا (٢١) لِلطَّاغِينَ مَآبًا (٢٢) لَابِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا (٢٣) لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا (٢٤) إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا (٢٥) جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا (٢٦)).
The words of the Exalted (لِلطَّاغِينَ): it may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مَآبًا», i.e. a place of return for the transgressors; or a naʿt (adjective) of «مِرْصَادًا»; or the lām may be attached (mutaʿalliq) to «مِرْصَادًا» itself.
(لَابِثِينَ) is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «الطَّاغِينَ» — an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara).
(أَحْقَابًا) is governed by «لَابِثِينَ». It is also said that it is governed by «لَا يَذُوقُونَ», and that by «أَحْقَابًا» here eternity is meant. «لَا يَذُوقُونَ» is another ḥāl, or a ḥāl from the pronoun in «لَابِثِينَ».
(جَزَاءً) is a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. they were recompensed with that by way of recompense.

ukberi-tibyan:28-29.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا كِذَّابًا (٢٨) وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَابًا (٢٩)).
(كِذَّابًا) with doubling is a maṣdar (verbal noun) like «التَّكْذِيب» (denial); and without doubling (كِذَابًا) it is the maṣdar of «كَذَبَ» when lying is repeated by him, and in meaning it is close to «كَذَبَ». (وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ) is accusative by an omitted verb. (كِتَابًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. written; and it may be a maṣdar according to the meaning, because «أَحْصَيْنَاهُ» means «كَتَبْنَاهُ» (We recorded it).

ukberi-tibyan:31-35.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا (٣١) حَدَائِقَ وَأَعْنَابًا (٣٢) وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا (٣٣) وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا (٣٤) لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّابًا (٣٥)). (حَدَائِقَ) is a badal (substitute) for «مَفَازًا».
(لَا يَسْمَعُونَ) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in the khabar (predicate) of «إِنَّ», and it may be resumptive (mustaʾnaf).

ukberi-tibyan:36-37.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (جَزَاءً مِنْ رَبِّكَ عَطَاءً حِسَابًا (٣٦) رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمَنِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا (٣٧)).
(عَطَاءً) is a noun standing for the maṣdar (ism al-maṣdar), and it is a badal (substitute) for «جَزَاءً».
(رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ) in the nominative (رَبُّ) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and there are two views on its khabar (predicate):
First: «الرَّحْمَنُ», in which case what follows it is another khabar, or resumptive.
Second: «الرَّحْمَنُ» is a naʿt (adjective), and «لَا يَمْلِكُونَ» is the khabar.
«رَبُّ» may also be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. «هُوَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ» (He is the Lord of the heavens), with «الرَّحْمَنُ» and what follows it as a mubtadaʾ and khabar. «رَبِّ» and «الرَّحْمَنِ» are also read in the genitive as a badal for «رَبِّكَ».

ukberi-tibyan:38-38.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الرُّوحُ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ صَفًّا لَا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَنُ. . .)).
The words of the Exalted (يَوْمَ يَقُومُ): it may be an adverb (ẓarf) for «لَا يَمْلِكُونَ», for «خِطَابًا», or for «لَا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ». «صَفًّا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

ukberi-tibyan:40-40.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (إِنَّا أَنْذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ. . . (٤٠)).
The words of the Exalted (يَوْمَ يَنْظُرُ): i.e. the punishment of a day, so it is a badal (substitute).
It may also be a naʿt (adjective) of «قَرِيبًا». And Allah knows best.
